question: What does your free inspection service for residential projects entail?
answer:
Our free inspection service at GCM Netting Solutions in Chennai is designed to provide you with a comprehensive assessment of your safety net needs. When you contact us, we'll schedule a visit to your residential property at your convenience. One of our experienced technicians will thoroughly inspect the area where you require safety nets, taking precise measurements and assessing potential hazards. This includes balconies, staircases, open areas, and any other location where fall protection is needed.

During the inspection, we'll discuss your specific requirements and recommend the most suitable type of safety net for your needs, considering factors like the height, area, and potential impact. We exclusively use high-quality HDPE material that is UV stabilized, ensuring durability and longevity even under the harsh Chennai sun. You'll receive a detailed quotation outlining the cost of materials and professional installation. All our installations come with a warranty ranging from 3 to 5 years, depending on the product. Our commitment is to provide you with the best possible solution to ensure the safety of your family. To schedule your free inspection and learn more about our safety nets in Chennai, call us today at +91 99123 99224. We are dedicated to providing reliable and professionally installed safety nets for residential projects across Chennai.
